deviations.what: G1-P and G1-P* (PRISM per-cell) cannot be computed at HPN, FRG (NYC), SMQ (EWR, TTN), LOM, CKZ (TTN), PWK, DPA, JOT (MDW) and FXE (MIA) for temperature, nor at HPN, FRG, SMQ, PWK, DPA, FXE for rain: Phase 1 kept only 40 km PRISM discs around each settlement station, and PRISM refuses a second download of the same file inside 24 h (the whole archive was pulled 2026-09-30 13:20-15:36Z). Those pairs are left out of the G1-P/G1-P* pooled statistics, and G1-N is also reported on the same reduced pair set so the two grids compare like for like. Pre-freeze version: every pair. Fill: re-pull PRISM after 2026-10-01 15:40Z with a wider disc and re-run.

PRISM .stn.csv contamination is measured on the single station list Phase 1 kept (2026-07-15, tmax and ppt), not as a share of test days; the other daily lists were discarded with the grid zips and cannot be re-downloaded inside 24 h.
deviations.pre_freeze: share of test days on which each truth station appears in .stn.csv

deviations.what: Station-value rule extended per 03-PLAN: at a non-CLI station with a GHCN-D USW record, IEM is compared with GHCN-D and replaced by GHCN-D if they differ on more than 2 % of days (same thresholds as the CLI check). Stations with neither (JRB, MMU, GYY, LOM, CKZ, IGQ, 06C; BLM in the outer ring) stay on IEM, unchecked.

Data-quality result (before any HE): every checked station fails the 2 % tmax check (IEM 0.4-0.9 F low on 39-68 % of days before 2025-10, 0-9 % after), so all CLI stations use CLI tmax and all non-CLI stations with a USW record use GHCN-D tmax; precip stays on IEM everywhere (0-1.5 % mismatch). The GHCN-D records for HST, WRI and JOT are empty in 2024 (train coverage 0 %), so these three have no train data. Frozen PC1 fits therefore give zero weight to any input with less than 50 % train coverage (HST in the MIA network, WRI in the TTN network) instead of dropping every train day. Decided before any HE was computed.
deviations.pre_freeze: PC1 fitted on train days with all inputs present

deviations.what: Added one post-hoc descriptive sensitivity, never gating: test window restricted to 2025-10-01..2026-08-31, the period in which IEM equals the CLI (CONVENTIONS section 8). Reason: seven stations have neither CLI nor GHCN-D (JRB, MMU, GYY, LOM, CKZ, IGQ, 06C) and stay on IEM, which is biased low before 2025-10 at every station where it could be checked.
